After having killed the guard, the prisoner of
war dragged him into the bushes and
changed into his clothes. Then he put the
rifle over his shoulder and marched up and
down in front of the camp. A short time
afterwards, four officers drove up in a car, so
he stood to attention and saluted. When they
had gone, the driver came towards him and
after he had knocked him out, the prisoner
jumped into the car and drove away.

the prisoner knocked him out. Then, jumping
into the car, he drove away.
